title: Hide Catalog Vortices In Tree By Default
description: By default all vortices from the catalog should not be shown in the puzzle3d kinds tree.
summary: Catalog vortices in the Puzzle 3D kinds tree are collapsed by default: object kinds with nested vortex templates use `defaultOpen: false`, and the top-level Vortices section starts closed. Users can expand rows to see vortex kind entries and object-kind template children.
